name: Buzzbox 411
summary: Along Darkshore, Buzzbox 411 waits for thresher eyes to bring it back into service. Wizbang Cranktoggle, an eccentric and intoxicated gnome inventor, reaches it through a mechanical relay network.

sections.title: Voice Through the Static
sections.body: After you repair Buzzbox 827 farther south, Wizbang Cranktoggle's voice crackles through the transmitter again. Hidden from sight, the gnome inventor directs you north along Darkshore's beach to the damaged Buzzbox 411. His words break with hiccups and praise for crawler wine. He says local aquatic predators carry what his coastal apparatus needs to work.

sections.title: Eyes Beneath the Surf
sections.body: Thresher eyes must go into Buzzbox 411's hatch to restore the machine. Darkshore threshers prowl the shallows off Auberdine, and Wizbang says their eyes can recalibrate the device. Feed the eyes to the apparatus, and it jolts back to life. Then the line opens for another assignment, delivered in an even slurrier voice.

faq.answer: Buzzbox 411 is a mechanical transmitter on the Darkshore shore, north of Auberdine. It belongs to an experimental listening and research network maintained by Wizbang Cranktoggle, a gnome engineer.

Wizbang Cranktoggle is an eccentric gnome tinkerer who speaks remotely through the Buzzbox network. He enjoys crawler wine during field research and relies on passing adventurers to gather animal parts in dangerous places.

faq.q: Why does a machine need Thresher Eyes?
faq.answer: Wizbang says thresher eyes are vital to repairing Buzzbox 411. Gnomish engineering sometimes joins organic matter with machines for unusual work, from optical sensors to biological research.
Buzzbox 411 is on the beach in Darkshore, north of the night elf settlement of Auberdine.

faq.q: Where do I find Darkshore Threshers?
faq.answer: Darkshore threshers swim in the coastal waters off Auberdine and along nearby shores. Swim beyond the surf to find them.

faq.q: What happens after Buzzbox 411 is fixed?
faq.answer: Once Buzzbox 411 hums back to life, Wizbang Cranktoggle thanks you through the static, drinks again, and asks you to fix his next machine, Buzzbox 323.

angles.text: Wizbang Cranktoggle shows an eccentric gnomish approach to fieldwork: bold invention, peculiar components, and leaving dangerous swimming to whoever happens by.
Using thresher eyes to calibrate a mechanical transmitter shows how far unconventional tinkerers will push their methods.
Auberdine's sentinels watch Darkshore's waters, though they usually leave peculiar gnomish contraptions on the shore to their own devices.
